test_nms_rotated_0_degree: test the nms_rotated function with 0 degree rotated boxes against a reference horizontal NMS implementation
test_batched_nms_rotated: test the batched_nms_rotated function comparing results against standard batched_nms for 0 degree boxes
test_nms_edit_distance: test the nms_edit_distance function to compare keep results from two NMS calls using dynamic programming
test_nms_rotated_90_180_degrees: test the nms_rotated function with 90 and 180 degree rotated boxes against reference horizontal NMS
test_nms_rotated_scriptable: test that nms_rotated can be compiled with torch.jit.script on both CPU and CUDA devices
